The H5 comes with an XY mic that records a stereo image with depth. Swap it for another mic capsule to suit the situation, much like changing lenses on an SLR camera. See Zoom H5/UG/04 Mics.
Besides the swappable stereo mic on the L/R inputs, the main unit has two XLR/TRS inputs, Inputs 1/2. See Zoom H5/UG/05 Inputs.
Together they record up to 4 tracks at once: for example ambience, narration, the overall sound and the voices of several performers.
The XY mic sits in a shock mount that reduces vibration noise. It handles sound pressure up to 140 dB SPL, louder than earlier recorders could capture, and records stereo with excellent separation.

With the L/R inputs, the H5 can record a backup file at the same time, 12 dB lower than the regular recording. Use the backup if an unexpected loud noise distorts the regular recording. See Zoom H5/UG/08 Recording/12 Backup Rec.
Every input has its own knob for quick gain adjustment.
The H5 records to SDHC cards up to 32 GB.
A line output jack sits alongside the headphone output, so the H5 can feed a video camera or other device while you monitor on headphones.
Over USB, the H5 works as a card reader, a 2-in/2-out audio interface, or a 4-in/2-out audio interface. Windows needs a driver for 4-in/2-out. See Zoom H5/UG/11 USB.
Like other H series recorders, it has a tuner, a metronome, and playback speed and pitch controls. A wired remote control is also available.
The left side carries the LINE OUT jack, the PHONE jack, the VOLUME +/− button for headphone and speaker level, the USB port, and the POWER/HOLD switch.
The XY mic sits on top, with its own Input volume L/R knob. Below the display are the Input volume 1 and Input volume 2 knobs, one per bottom input.
The Track buttons L, R, 1 and 2 select which inputs record; each has an indicator above it.
The transport buttons are STOP, PLAY/PAUSE, REC with its indicator, Back, and Forward.
The right side carries the REMOTE jack, the scroll button, the MENU button, and the SD card slot.
Move the scroll button up or down to select menu items. Press it to choose the selected item.

Press MENU to open the menu or return to the previous screen.

The XY mic has a MIC/LINE input jack that supports Zoom H5/UG/13 Settings/04 Plug-in Power.
The speaker and the battery cover are on the back.
Input 1 and Input 2 are XLR/TRS combo jacks on the bottom, with a strap attachment hole between them.
XLR wiring: pin 1 GND, pin 2 HOT, pin 3 COLD.
TRS wiring: tip HOT, ring COLD, sleeve GND.
The XY mic that comes with the H5 can be swapped for another input capsule to suit the recording.
Two directional mics cross at 90°, one aimed left and one aimed right.
A shock mount reduces vibration noise from handling.
The mic handles sound pressure up to 140 dB SPL.
It records stereo with natural depth and width.
Press the buttons on both sides of the mic, then push it onto the main unit until it is fully seated.
Press the buttons on both sides of the mic and pull it off the main unit.
Besides the L/R inputs on the XY mic, the H5 has Input 1 and Input 2 on the bottom of the main unit. Use all of them together to record up to 4 tracks at once.
